analysis.caveat: Diagnostic-only. CPU phases are elapsed wall intervals; GPU stage times overlap them. GPU records cover only the exact final submission, not prior retries. Correlation is not causation. Unassigned wall time is not automatically scheduling time. Missing GPU rows retain their denominator.

over_50ms.note: Largest of timed GPU categories, not proof it caused the wall delay; categories do not cover all work/waits.

caveat: All 1000-action totals, first full frame, outliers and raw data remain preserved in the primary analysis. This subset is for attribution only, never acceptance.
